acceptance.given: Historical Bootstrap, TDD, acceptance, freeze, and implementation reports are available as read-only inputs before Package A work.

oracle.expected: A post-work preservation check confirms every named historical report retains its original content and remains present.
forbidden: Any named historical report is modified, rewritten, deleted, or replaced by Package A.
oracle.observable: The preservation check compares pre-work and post-work report contents and presence.

acceptance.then: The preservation check reports no content or presence differences for the historical reports.
acceptance.when: After Package A work completes, run the historical-report preservation check against the captured pre-work report set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run a preservation check that detects any changed, missing, deleted, or replaced named historical Bootstrap, TDD, acceptance, freeze, or implementation report after Package A work.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or execute a preservation check proving Package A does not alter historical reports.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Historical report contents and locations remain byte-for-byte compatible and preserved.

slice_hint.state_transition: Historical reports remain read-only inputs throughout Package A work and are verified unchanged afterward.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The preservation check completes with every named historical report present and content-identical to its pre-work snapshot.
